get.summary: Store name, the locales it offers, the available sign-up/sign-in methods and checkout settings.
All categories with their sub-categories, for menus and the home page, named in the requested locale.
Published products for a list (discounted, newest), named in the requested locale.
One published product by its public number, with images, specs and its slug in every translated language.
The product's slug in the requested locale, for redirecting old or wrong product addresses.

post.summary: Create a customer account with an email or mobile number and sign in.
Sign in with email or mobile number and password.
Sign out (clears the session cookie).

get.summary: The signed-in user, with roles and permissions.

post.summary: Text a one-time sign-in code to a mobile number (same answer whether or not it has an account).
Sign in with the SMS code; a new number gets a customer account.
Text a code to a number the signed-in user wants to add.
Save the number as the user's verified phone with the SMS code.
Confirm an email address with the token from the confirmation email.
Send the confirmation email again to the signed-in user.
Email a password reset link, if an account uses this email.
Set a new password with the token from the reset email; signs out all other sessions.

get.summary: Providers this shop offers and the ones linked to the signed-in account.
Browser navigation: redirects to the provider's sign-in page.
Browser navigation: end of the provider round trip; signs in and redirects into the storefront.
Browser navigation: link a provider to the signed-in account.
Browser navigation: end of the link round trip.

post.summary: Unlink a provider (refused when it is the account's only way to sign in).
Complete a sign-in with the authenticator app's code.
Complete a sign-in with a one-time recovery code.

get.summary: Whether two-step sign-in is on, recovery codes left, and whether it is required for this account.

post.summary: The key and otpauth:// URI (QR code) for the authenticator app.
Turn on two-step sign-in with a first code from the app; returns recovery codes (shown once).
Turn off two-step sign-in (needs a current code; refused for staff when it is required).
Replace all recovery codes (needs a current code).
Ask for the second step again on this device.

put.summary: Change the display name and the language of emails and SMS.

post.summary: Change the password (needs the current one); other sessions end.

get.summary: Everything the shop stores about the signed-in customer, as a JSON file.

post.summary: Delete the account: personal data is erased, orders stay anonymously. Needs the password, or a recent sign-in for accounts without one.

get.summary: The address book, default address first.

post.summary: Add an address (the first one becomes the default).

delete.summary: Delete an address (for real; the next one becomes the default).

post.summary: Make an address the default.

get.summary: Staff members with their roles and status, and recent invitations.

post.summary: Invite someone by email or mobile number with one or more staff roles (valid 7 days).

put.summary: Replace a staff member's roles (not your own; at least one active Admin stays).

post.summary: Block every sign-in of a staff member; open sessions end within a minute.
Allow a suspended staff member to sign in again.
Take away every staff role; the account stays a customer account.

get.summary: The latest 100 staff changes: who did what, to whom, and when.
Open staff invitations for the signed-in user's verified email or mobile number.

post.summary: Accept an invitation: its roles are added and this session is refreshed.

CheckoutSettings.description: Checkout rules: whether customers may buy without an account, and where the shop ships (ISO country codes).

ProductSlugResponse.description: The product's slug in the requested language (the storefront redirects any other slug to it).

SignInMethods.description: Sign-in methods currently available (SMS codes need a configured SMS provider).

SignUpMethods.description: Sign-up methods currently available (phone needs a configured SMS provider).

StoreInfoResponse.description: Store settings the storefront needs; `Currency` is the base currency of all prices (ISO 4217).
